snippet.title: Let's Freeze Some Penguins! - Official Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Walnut the Walrus sets out to save his friends, and all of Northern Bear, from the dreaded Emperor Penguin. Luckily, his chilly Walrus Wind is ice cold. Now let’s freeze some penguins!

Wishlist on STEAM now!

Developer: Neckbolt
Publisher: Burning Planet Digital
